messages:
Alex: quick check — i'm about to land a terraform change that adjusts the HPA for inference-service-prod from targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 60 -> 50 and adds a topologySpreadConstraint so pods don't all land on the same AZ. also adding a nodeSelector for karpenter.sh/provisioner-name=inference-prod-provisioner. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/4321
Priya: thanks for the heads up. what's the escalation if lowering CPU target triggers scale-ups and we hit quota? do we have a fallback? :thinking_face:
Alex: good call — plan is to add a scaleDown stabilizationWindowSeconds and conservative minReplicas=2 for now. for fallback infra-bot will reroute to inference-fallback model variant if pod startup latency > 3s for 30s. config snippet i'm applying:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: inference-service-prod
spec:
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 40
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300
```
Jared: minor nit — the nodeSelector will stop some spot instances from being used if the label doesn't match. did you update karpenter provisioner tolerations/labels to allow spot and on-demand?
Alex: yes i updated the provisioner in the PR to include labels and weights, excerpt:
```hcl
resource "karpenter_provisioner" "inference_prod" {
  labels = { "karpenter.sh/provisioner-name" = "inference-prod-provisioner" }
  requirements = ["kubernetes.io/arch=amd64"]
  provider {
    capacityTypes = ["spot","on-demand"]
    weights = { "spot" = 70, "on-demand" = 30 }
  }
}
```
Emma: also FYI i'm changing the secret name we mount from `inference-creds` -> `inference-prod-creds` to avoid cross-env usage. CI job needs an update (deploy pipeline). i've added a follow-up commit to the PR.
Priya: can you add a note in the PR description about secret rename and required pipeline env var update? made that mistake before. :sweat_smile:
Alex: done. added checklist and rollback steps. i've scheduled a canary rollout (10% traffic) for 30 minutes, then 50% then full. will watch pod startup latency and kube events.
infra-bot: automated checks: terraform fmt OK, k8s manifests lint OK, security-scan flagged: secret-name-change requires update to secret-rotation policy. see https://scans.company/scan/8972
Jared: thanks infra-bot. i'll take the secret-rotation change in a follow-up ticket. Alex — when you do the canary, ping #oncall if latency > 2.5s.
Alex: will do. landing in ~30m unless objections. :thumbsup:
